name: The Solvay Concord
tagline: Where gravity bends, contracts shift, and trust is currency…
premise: A fractured interstellar federation of planetary governments, megacorporations, and alien species, bound by shared economic systems and political rivalries, where biological engineering shapes society and trade is governed by biological credit, not money.
tone: Calmly dystopian, precise, grounded in bureaucratic realism…

origin.description: An interstellar society with competing planetary governments, advanced biotechnology, megacorporations, alien species and complex economic systems. I begin as an indebted freighter mechanic on an orbital station.

rules.name: Gravity Tuning
rules.summary: You can tune gravity in a cargo module by inserting a gravity-tuning seed and running it through a tissue-sense sensor.

success.text: The fiber is weak and must be used immediately or degrade.

rules.name: Biocredit Resonance
rules.summary: When you use a trust calibration cube near a biocredit exchange, you can briefly detect if someone is lying about their balance.

success.text: The cube emits a soft hum — a nearby trader is over-declaring their biocredit balance by 40%.

rules.name: Self-Healing Adaptation
rules.summary: If you're injured, you can use a healing-by-adaptation vial to trigger a biological healing cascade in your tissues.

success.text: The vial was drawn from your own tissue — it now cannot be used again.
